Question: Get orders with customer names
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT o."orderNumber", c."customerName" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

Question: Get employees with office city
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT e."firstName", e."lastName", o.city FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e."officeCode" = o."officeCode";

Question: Get payments with customer names
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT p."paymentDate", p.amount, c."customerName" FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

Question: Get order details with product names
Intent: Link line items to product names
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT od."orderNumber", p."productName", od."quantityOrdered", od."priceEach" FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od."productCode" = p."productCode";

Question: Get products with product line desc
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT p."productName", pl."textDescription" FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p."productLine" = pl."productLine";

Question: Get customers with sales rep names
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT c."customerName", e."firstName" AS "repFirstName", e."lastName" AS "repLastName" FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c."salesRepEmployeeNumber" = e."employeeNumber";

Question: Get orders with customer city
Intent: Link orders to purchasing customer city
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT o."orderNumber", c.city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

Question: Get employees and their manager
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT e."firstName" AS "Employee", m."firstName" AS "Manager" FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e."reportsTo" = m."employeeNumber";

Question: Get orderdetails with product vendor
Intent: Link line items to product vendor
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT od."orderNumber", p."productVendor" FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od."productCode" = p."productCode";

Question: Get payments with customer country
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT p.amount, c.country FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

Question: Count customers per country
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS "customerCount" FROM customers GROUP BY country;

Question: Total payments per customer
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT "customerNumber", SUM(amount) AS "totalPayments" FROM payments GROUP BY "customerNumber";

Question: Number of orders per status
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS "orderCount" FROM orders GROUP BY status;

Question: Products per product line
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT "productLine", COUNT(*) AS "productCount" FROM products GROUP BY "productLine";

Question: Employees per office
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT "officeCode", COUNT(*) AS "employeeCount" FROM employees GROUP BY "officeCode";

Question: Total stock per product vendor
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT "productVendor", SUM("quantityInStock") AS "totalStock" FROM products GROUP BY "productVendor";

Question: Average buy price per product line
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT "productLine", AVG("buyPrice") AS "avgBuyPrice" FROM products GROUP BY "productLine";

Question: Orders per customer
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT "customerNumber", COUNT(*) AS "orderCount" FROM orders GROUP BY "customerNumber";

Question: Max MSRP per product line
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT "productLine", MAX("MSRP") AS "maxMSRP" FROM products GROUP BY "productLine";

Question: Min buy price per vendor
Ground Truth SQL: SELECT "productVendor", MIN("buyPrice") AS "minBuyPrice" FROM products GROUP BY "productVendor";
